races.name: Summer Social Events At Southwell Racecourse Handicap

runners_data.name: Clansman
runners_data.note: Front-running style suits small field but 8-year-old stamina question over this trip with regular recent racing
runners_data.comment: Possible front-runner; high marks for consistency this year; sound claims
runners_data.spotlight: Possible front-runner; high marks for consistency this year and managed a win at Newcastle in March; Toby Moore got a good tune out of him here the following month; sound claims.

runners_data.name: Betelgeuse
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suited to race shape, excellent recent Southwell form and gelding operation has clearly helped
runners_data.comment: Fine second a fortnight ago (pair clear; PB); major player if putting best foot forward
runners_data.spotlight: Has form figures of 152, all over 1m6f here, since a gelding operation; routed eight rivals then proved bitterly disappointing 15 days later; back from over five months off with fine second a fortnight ago (pair clear; PB); major player if putting best foot forward.

runners_data.name: Westlain
runners_data.note: Returning from 70-day break after hurdles success but lacks recent flat experience and needs to prove stamina
runners_data.comment: Won twice over hurdles and is now asked to go further back on the level; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Pick of Flat form when close third at Lingfield last June (11.6f; turf; Betelgeuse behind); won twice over hurdles since and is now asked to go further back on the level; interesting candidate.

runners_data.name: Volcanic Rock
runners_data.note: Prominent style could be ideal compromise position with Oisin Murphy's tactical nous a major asset

runners_data.name: Dollar's Dream
runners_data.note: Strong recent staying form and hold-up style suits but Philip Kirby's poor recent strike rate is concerning
runners_data.comment: Passed over, mainly because he looked awkward under pressure here latest
runners_data.spotlight: Very pleasing second, behind one who readily followed up next time, over the extended 2m at Newcastle in January; passed up a good opportunity next time and looked awkward under pressure latest (both 1m6f here); others preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Clansman will dictate from the front as the sole confirmed leader, with Volcanic Rock likely to settle prominently behind him. The middle distance and standard going conditions should allow Clansman to set a manageable tempo without early pressure. Betelgeuse, Westlain and Dollar's Dream will all be held up in the small field, creating a tactical race where the pace-setter gets first run but faces a wall of hold-up horses with finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can time their challenge, as Clansman will be a sitting duck if his stamina cracks in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady and Clansman weakens in the final 2f
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of Betelgeuse and Dollar's Dream pay dividends as they sweep past a tiring leader. Their superior finishing kicks and fresh legs prove decisive in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Clansman maintains his stamina and the hold-up horses leave it too late
scenarios.body: The leader's honest galloping and race fitness keeps him ahead of late challengers who find the sustained pace has taken its toll. His early advantage proves insurmountable despite the finishing efforts behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Volcanic Rock can bridge the gap between leader and hold-up horses perfectly
scenarios.body: The Godolphin runner gets the best of both worlds by tracking Clansman closely then having enough left to repel the late challenges. His prominent position allows him to kick clear when the others are still making ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Westlain Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the returning hurdler shows unexpected flat speed and times his run perfectly
scenarios.body: His fresh legs from the 70-day break and hurdles fitness give him a different dimension to his finish. The lack of recent flat form becomes an advantage as he catches the others napping.

watchPoints.text: Betelgeuse must be watched closely for market confidence given his excellent recent course form and perfect hold-up style
Clansman's stamina over this extended trip needs monitoring as his recent efforts have been shorter
Westlain's fitness levels after 70 days off flat racing despite hurdles wins in between
Dollar's Dream's ability to overcome trainer Philip Kirby's poor recent form figures of 0/12
Volcanic Rock's response to step back up in distance after recent shorter efforts

races.name: Book The Bistro In Sherwood Restaurant EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Estupenda
runners_data.comment: Local trainer yet to have a 2yo winner since starting up in Britain but market check wise
runners_data.spotlight: April foal; price rose from 26,000euros to 65,000gns as a yearling; second foal out of unraced sister to 1m2f winner Wondrous Words; local trainer yet to have a 2yo winner since starting up in Britain but market check wise.

runners_data.name: Frumoasa
runners_data.comment: Trainer had a 2yo win first time out under Paddy Bradley at Nottingham this month
runners_data.spotlight: January foal; 44,000gns yearling; third foal out of 6f winner (including 2yo Listed/AW; RPR 96); trainer had a 2yo win first time out under Paddy Bradley at Nottingham this month; watch market.

runners_data.name: Quiet Soul
runners_data.comment: First 2yo runner of the year for Michael Dods and makes some appeal
runners_data.spotlight: March foal costing 15,000euros; seventh foal; half-sister to four winners, including Mamba Wamba (Listed-placed 5f/5.4f, including 2yo/USA AW; RPR 96); dam 6f 2yo/1m winner (76); first 2yo runner of the year for Michael Dods and makes some appeal.

runners_data.name: Sable Island
runners_data.comment: Trainer not noted for first-time-out 2yo winners; probably best watched
runners_data.spotlight: March foal; second foal out of 5f winner (including AW; RPR 76); trainer not noted for first-time-out 2yo winners; probably best watched.

runners_data.name: Bellatina
runners_data.comment: Obvious claims of going one better than on debut at Beverley a fortnight ago
runners_data.spotlight: Ran much better than market suggested she would over this trip at Beverley a fortnight ago, finding just one who had the benefit of experience too strong and finishing in front of a seemingly well-regarded Karl Burke/Amo newcomer who runs at Bath later today; obvious claims.

runners_data.name: Havana Gift
runners_data.comment: No surprise if lasting longer with debut run under her belt
runners_data.spotlight: Showed good speed before tiring when fourth of six on debut at Thirsk 11 days ago (5f; 12-1); no surprise if lasting longer with that run under her belt.

runners_data.name: Crimson Blaze
runners_data.comment: Very green when fifth of eight on debut; likely involved with Oisin Murphy booked
runners_data.spotlight: Very green when managing fifth of eight on debut at Wolverhampton this month (5f; 11-2); the filly who finished just in front of her there scored next time; likely involved with Oisin Murphy booked.

runners_data.name: Wopbopaloomop
runners_data.comment: Much better expected here having been left poorly placed when sent off favourite on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Unable to justify favouritism on debut at Redcar last week (5f), not ideally placed but making a fair mid-race move before effort flattened out; tongue-tie goes on; close relation Candy improved with racing and ultimately won the Two Year Old Trophy at Redcar.

races.name: Come Racing For Free 18th June Handicap

runners_data.name: Flash Kozo
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 39-day break with breeding for this longer trip, could strip fitter second-up
runners_data.comment: Better effort here 39 days ago despite still looking green; up in trip for handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Better effort here 39 days ago despite still looking green; dam winning over 1m4f offers hope for this marked step up in trip; betting useful on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Al's River
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up in distance after gelding operation, showed low-key return but may improve
runners_data.comment: Low-key sixth on return/handicap debut (upped to 1m2f; 9-2; behind Extraterrestrial)
runners_data.spotlight: Improved placing each start last year but, having been gelded, he returned with a low-key sixth on handicap debut at Nottingham three weeks ago (upped to 1m2f; 9-2; behind Extraterrestrial); rather watch.

runners_data.name: Extraterrestrial
runners_data.note: Takes strong hold and hasn't benefited from visor addition, needs to settle better to be effective
runners_data.comment: Twice third in handicap company at bit shorter than this; possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: Twice third in handicap company at bit shorter than this, with the fitting of a visor not really helping at Nottingham three weeks ago (took good hold); less-severe headgear is reached for here; possibilities if settling better.

runners_data.name: Magician Of Riga
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner over similar trips with solid recent form, likely to set uncontested fractions
runners_data.comment: Tough to beat given manner of breakthrough win; 5lb rise could have been worse
runners_data.spotlight: Pleasing third of five when stepped up to 1m4f at Wolverhampton last month and did the business under those conditions next time, getting the better of the hot favourite; had over 2l to spare at the line and a 5lb rise could have been worse; tough to beat.

runners_data.name: Gemical
runners_data.note: Long absence of 191 days makes fitness a major concern despite hold-up style suiting race shape
runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten in trio of Irish maidens at up to 8.3f on turf last year for Kevin Coleman
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten in trio of Irish maidens at up to 8.3f on turf last year for Kevin Coleman; probably best watched unless the betting speaks positively.

runners_data.name: Wave Power
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 202 days off, entitled to improve but fitness remains questionable
runners_data.comment: Could win a race at about 1m3f but is entitled to strip fitter for this return
runners_data.spotlight: No forlorn hope on runs two and three last year, and moving up in trip promises to suit, but he's entitled to strip fitter for this return; gelded in his time off; AW/handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Singarda
runners_data.note: Closest to frame last time at Ripon following wind surgery, new trip raises stamina questions
runners_data.comment: Fair fifth on return but new trip raises a question
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to make the frame but came closest to doing so on his return at Ripon 13 days ago (1m; following wind surgery); new trip raises a question.

races.paceDynamic: Magician Of Riga is the sole confirmed pace-setter and will face minimal early pressure from Al's River and Extraterrestrial who prefer prominent positions but won't challenge for the lead. This creates a controlled tempo scenario where the front-runner can dictate fractions without being harassed through the early and middle stages. The race sets up perfectly for hold-up horses like Flash Kozo, Singarda, and Wave Power to close strongly in the final 2-3 furlongs. This pace shape heavily favours closers who can benefit from the honest but uncontested gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Closing Kick
scenarios.trigger: If Magician Of Riga leads uncontested and sets moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The pace allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and mount telling late challenges over this stamina-testing trip. Flash Kozo and Singarda are ideally positioned to benefit from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Magician Of Riga gets soft early sections and kicks clear
scenarios.body: Having won over 1m4f last time, he can exploit the lack of pace pressure to build an unassailable lead. The step up in trip plays to his strengths with no sustained early challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Al's River or Extraterrestrial sit closer and time their move perfectly
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners capitalises on sitting in the slipstream before striking in the final furlong. Al's River showed improvement after gelding and could peak second-up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Magician Of Riga goes too slow and gets swamped by closers
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure creates pedestrian fractions that allow every hold-up horse to get competitive. Multiple closers converge simultaneously in a bunch finish.

watchPoints.text: Magician Of Riga getting uncontested lead - if he settles well early he becomes very hard to peg back
Flash Kozo's fitness after 39-day layoff - any market support would be significant on handicap debut
Al's River and Extraterrestrial settling in behind rather than pressuring the pace setter early
Gemical and Wave Power showing any signs of zip despite long absences - both need to prove fitness
Pace through opening half-mile - if too slow it plays into hands of every closer in the field

races.name: Celebrate With Sponsorship At Southwell Racecourse Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Donna Nook
runners_data.note: Front-running style with sustainable pace-setting ability, returns from 93-day break but should have fitness edge in small field
runners_data.comment: Her losing run continues but she has another career-low mark and might not be far away
runners_data.spotlight: 0-15 since winning in December 2024 on her second start but she ran a couple of reasonable races this January and returns from a break on another career-low mark; effective over C&D and might not be far away.

runners_data.name: Welljudged
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who may struggle for room in closing stages, represents top trainer Roger Varian returning from 67-day layoff
runners_data.comment: Disappointing on sole handicap start but has shown promise otherwise; a case can be made
runners_data.spotlight: Disappointing at Wolverhampton (8.6f, Tapeta) in January on sole handicap start but she showed promise previously (including here) and 7f looked inadequate in a maiden at Chelmsford in February last time, when third; could play a leading role back up in trip and back in a handicap.

runners_data.name: Brave Byreflection
runners_data.note: Hold-up style on stable debut for James Evans, needed recent Kempton run and faces traffic concerns
runners_data.comment: Below last winning mark but has to raise game in a big way on second start of the season
runners_data.spotlight: She's below her last winning mark and may have needed the run at Kempton this month on her stable debut; however, her form was patchy last season and her claims aren't compelling.

runners_data.name: Electric Avenue
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with proven all-weather form but well below best recent efforts, wearing tongue tie
runners_data.comment: Won off 2lb higher at Newcastle last November; long way below that level on last 4 starts
runners_data.spotlight: Won off 2lb higher at Newcastle (1m, Tapeta) last November but she's been a long way below that level on her last four starts.

runners_data.name: Alessia Fernanda
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 188-day break after wind surgery, 7lb drop in weights could rejuvenate
runners_data.comment: Form went wrong way last season but she's had wind surgery and is on a dangerous mark
runners_data.spotlight: Her form went the wrong way last season but she returns having had wind surgery and is 7lb lower than when winning on her reappearance last April; trainer had a double here last Saturday; capable of having a big say.

runners_data.name: Cosi Bear
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the likely pace scenario, down in grade after disappointing polytrack runs
runners_data.comment: Hasn't shone this year but she's still very lightly raced and her yard is in fine form
runners_data.spotlight: Following a long layoff she's been down the field in a Kempton novice (7f, Polytrack) and a Lingfield handicap (1m, Polytrack) on her two runs this year; however, she remains very lightly raced and she showed plenty of promise here in October 2024; yard in fine form; no surprise to see a big run.

runners_data.name: Dream Illusion
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with three wins this year including two course and distance victories, proven in similar pace scenarios
runners_data.comment: Three wins this year (two over C&D) and undone by slow pace over C&D last time; a possible
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins this year (two over C&D) and bounced back from disappointing Newcastle run with close sixth of eight over C&D this month, when the slow pace was against her; possible player.

runners_data.name: Wondrous Light
runners_data.note: Hold-up style coming off recent Beverley turf win, faces 3lb penalty but has winning form fresh
runners_data.comment: Won on recent reappearance at Beverley; strong claims if return to Tapeta isn't an issue
runners_data.spotlight: Having dropped back down to her last winning mark she's scored on her reappearance at Beverley (8.4f, turf) a fortnight ago; strong claims back up 3lb provided the return to Tapeta isn't an issue.

runners_data.name: Special Breeze
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner on just second handicap start, showed promise in recent Beverley fourth
runners_data.comment: Not beaten far on h'cap debut; pedigree provides optimism that she'll have more to offer
runners_data.spotlight: Ran okay when 5l fourth of five in C&D novice last September and it was her first run since when beaten only about 3l in sixth of ten on handicap debut at Beverley (8.4f, turf) a fortnight ago; her pedigree provides optimism that she'll have more to offer and she could be a contender.

races.paceDynamic: Donna Nook will set a sustainable early pace from the front with no obvious speed rivals to challenge her early. The prominent runners Alessia Fernanda and Cosi Bear will track close behind, while the large hold-up contingent of Welljudged, Brave Byreflection, Electric Avenue, Dream Illusion, Wondrous Light and Special Breeze will be fighting for racing room in the closing stages. With only one natural front-runner in a small field, this creates an honest gallop that builds gradually rather than a sprint finish. This pace scenario clearly favours front-running and prominent racing styles who can secure good positions and avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Donna Nook maintains her lead without being pressed early and the pace stays true throughout.
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed pressure allows the front-runners to dictate terms while the large hold-up brigade gets bunched up approaching the final furlong. Front-runners and prominent racers hold their advantage as the closers run out of time and room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Traffic Problems
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses struggle for clear runs in the straight due to the small field bunching.
scenarios.body: Several hold-up runners get squeezed for room as they all move at once, allowing the early positioned horses to maintain their advantage. The pace-setters capitalize on the trouble behind them.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If one of the better hold-up horses finds a clear passage and the pace becomes truly testing late.
scenarios.body: The honest gallop sets up perfectly for a talented closer to sweep past tired leaders in the final 100 yards. Quality hold-up runners with tactical speed prove too strong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Donna Nook goes too slow early and the race becomes a sprint from the 3f pole.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure creates a crawling pace that turns into a cavalry charge, suiting horses with a turn of foot regardless of preferred style. The race becomes a lottery in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Donna Nook could get an uncontested lead if no prominent runners press her early, making her very dangerous
Traffic problems likely in straight as seven hold-up runners converge simultaneously in small field
Wondrous Light brings recent winning form but turf to all-weather switch after Beverley success needs monitoring
Alessia Fernanda returns from longest layoff in field after wind surgery, fitness versus class question
Dream Illusion has best recent course form with two wins here but needs pace pressure to be effective

races.name: Dog Friendly Raceday Tues 2nd June Handicap (Div I)

runners_data.name: Kondratiev Wave
runners_data.note: Front runner who should get uncontested lead but 1m may stretch stamina having shown best form over 7f recently
runners_data.comment: Has the assistance of Oisin Murphy; 1m around here just stretches him
runners_data.spotlight: In good form over 7f of late, recording win number eight at Lingfield two starts ago (dead-heat); has the assistance of Oisin Murphy, but 1m around here just stretches him.

runners_data.name: Shaws Phoenix
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 248-day break after wind surgery for new yard, hard to assess fitness levels
runners_data.comment: 0-15; likely best watched back from break and wind surgery for another new yard
runners_data.spotlight: 0-15 and starts out for another new yard (trained last two years by Alice Haynes) off a 248-day break having undergone wind surgery; goes without headgear; likely best watched.

runners_data.name: The Spotlight Kid
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse twice a back-to-back winner who was narrowly beaten over course and distance, may need race fitness after 58-day break
runners_data.comment: Player if he's not too fresh back from a short break and can be settled
runners_data.spotlight: Twice won back to back and has been knocking on the door of late, loudest when going down by a neck over C&D in January; player if he's not too fresh back from a short break and can be settled.

runners_data.name: Pink Socks
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won hat-trick here but form has declined since switching yards to Stephanie Cassidy
runners_data.comment: January hat-trick but hard to fancy on recent evidence
runners_data.spotlight: Legs two and three of her January hat-trick for Ian Williams came here (7f/1m); went off the boil for him and hard to fancy on what she's done in three starts for this yard.

runners_data.name: Manton Road
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse and regular slow starter whose four wins came in pairs, struggles for trainer Richard Phillips recently
runners_data.comment: Not beaten all that far in two runs since leaving Gay Kelleway but more is needed from him
runners_data.spotlight: Regular slow starter; like The Spotlight Kid, his four wins have come in two lots of two; not beaten all that far in his two runs since leaving Gay Kelleway but more is needed from him.

runners_data.name: Kessaar Power
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from handy stall 1 draw with Silvestre De Sousa up, failed to beat rival in last two starts but fresher after break
runners_data.comment: Failed to beat a rival the last twice but there are grounds for some optimism
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival on last two outings but may have been rejuvenated by a short break and stall 1 is handy given he normally makes the running; Silvestre De Sousa is a positive booking too.

runners_data.name: Borderline Madness
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won twice last year and ran well when second over course and distance, recent return should have sharpened fitness
runners_data.comment: Recent return should have blown the cobwebs away and a 1lb drop allows her into this 0-55
runners_data.spotlight: Dual winner last year and matched best form when finding just one too good over C&D in November; recent return at Yarmouth should have blown the cobwebs away and a 1lb drop allows her into this 0-55.

runners_data.name: Ring Of Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who pairs well with Billy Garritty and will benefit from strong pace, solid recent form over 7f
runners_data.comment: Should get the pace he needs but does seem more effective over 7f
runners_data.spotlight: Billy Garritty gets on well with him (form figures together read 421125) and the likes of Kessaar Power should ensure this is truly run, which will suit this hold-up performer; he does seem more effective over 7f, though.

runners_data.name: Starshot
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with tongue-tie returning after failing to settle last week, showed good form in March under Sean Kirrane
runners_data.comment: Two good runs in March but failed to settle when down the field last week
runners_data.spotlight: 1-41; back-to-back good runs under Sean Kirrane in March but gave himself no chance of troubling the judge last week by failing to settle; usual tongue-tie returns.

runners_data.name: Vecchio
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse mostly disappointing for Scott Dixon yard including over course and distance last time
runners_data.comment: Mostly down the field for this yard, including over C&D last time; can't be supported
runners_data.spotlight: Mostly down the field for this yard, including over C&D last time; can't be supported.

runners_data.name: Mavetheforcebewivu
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from recent break but yet to get within length of winning in career
runners_data.comment: Should be all the better for her recent return to action but others are preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Should be all the better for her recent return to action but is yet to get within a length of winning and others are preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Kondratiev Wave and Kessaar Power will lead early, with Shaws Phoenix and Pink Socks tracking in prominent positions. The pace should be sustainable rather than fierce given only one confirmed front runner in Kondratiev Wave, though Kessaar Power from stall 1 may press if keen. This moderate gallop will allow the field to stay in touch through the middle sections before quickening from 3f out. The steady pace and flat 1m trip strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly, particularly those with proven tactical speed like The Spotlight Kid, Ring Of Gold and Borderline Madness.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Kondratiev Wave controlling from the front
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks in the final 2f when the early pace-setters tire. This scenario perfectly suits closers with tactical speed who thrive when getting a tow into the race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Pink Socks or Shaws Phoenix travel well in behind the leaders and kick approaching 2f out
scenarios.body: The prominently-raced horses get first run on the field before the hold-up brigade can organize their challenges. Their early position advantage proves decisive as they find enough in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Kessaar Power from stall 1 presses Kondratiev Wave and creates a genuine test early
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop stretches the field and finds out the stamina reserves, with only the most genuine stayers able to respond to pressure. This tough pace eliminates the less hardy types.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the market principles fail to fire and an unfancied runner produces career-best form
scenarios.body: A surprise package from the back markers capitalizes on a perfectly run race to spring a shock result. The unexpected winner benefits from the focus being on the fancied runners.

watchPoints.text: Kondratiev Wave may not see out the 1m trip having shown best recent form over 7f and could stop quickly if pressed
Shaws Phoenix faces fitness concerns on 248-day return from wind surgery and may need this run to come fully right
Kessaar Power from stall 1 could set faster fractions than expected if he breaks keenly under Silvestre De Sousa
The Spotlight Kid and Borderline Madness both returning from breaks may lack peak race fitness despite their strong profiles
Ring Of Gold pairs exceptionally well with Billy Garritty and could outrun odds if getting his favoured strong pace

races.name: Dog Friendly Raceday Tues 2nd June Handicap (Div II)

runners_data.name: Heretic
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning to optimal 1m trip after disappointing over shorter, with solid C&D record
runners_data.comment: Back-to-back C&D wins last October; returns to favourite trip here
runners_data.spotlight: Back-to-back C&D wins last October (off 3lb lower than today, then 3lb higher than today); should appreciate returning to 1m having produced a lesser effort over 7f here last time; can be involved.

runners_data.name: Timely Affair
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist gets first-time cheekpieces and top jockey Oisin Murphy, but needs pace collapse
runners_data.comment: The one to beat under Oisin Murphy, who is 9-28 for the yard in the last five years
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten favourite three times since breaking through over C&D in January but his last two efforts were sound; first-time headgear (cheekpieces) could help to focus him and Oisin Murphy is 9-28 (+12.68) for the yard in the last five years; the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Ribston Pippin
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 39-day break, previously effective over C&D when beating market leaders
runners_data.comment: Productive first season as a 3yo in 2025; could leave his modest return behind
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins in first season as a 3yo included a beating of the two clear market leaders plus Spirit Of Bowland over C&D in December; modest return to action under same conditions last month but could leave that behind today; Jason Hart, who gets aboard him for the first time, is 1-1 for the trainer.

runners_data.name: Back From Dubai
runners_data.note: Experienced prominent racer with five course wins, line through most recent poor C&D effort
runners_data.comment: Could feasibly bounce back if left alone in front
runners_data.spotlight: Has won five times here; a line can be put through his most recent C&D run and he didn't get any peace out in front at Nottingham 11 days ago (weakened into eighth of ten); it wouldn't be the biggest surprise to see him bounce back (there is possible competition for the lead but no other out-and-out front-runners).

runners_data.name: Spirit Of Bowland
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won this division last year and recent C&D classified race 34 days ago
runners_data.comment: Should go well, for all that he might be vulnerable to younger legs

races.paceDynamic: Our Misty Blue is the sole confirmed pace-setter but carries warning flags for fading in the finish, suggesting he may not sustain his early lead. With only one horse committed to making the running, several prominent racers like Heretic, Ribston Pippin and Back From Dubai will likely fill the forward positions, creating a moderate early gallop rather than fierce pressure. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Timely Affair, Spirit Of Bowland, Cezarro and Unknown Journey will be relying on the pace collapsing in the final furlong. This tactical setup clearly favours prominent racers who can track the lone leader without being taken out of their comfort zone.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Our Misty Blue sets a steady tempo without burning out completely
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows prominent runners to stay in touch and kick clear when the hold-up brigade get going too late. Heretic and Ribston Pippin benefit from their forward positions to strike in the final quarter-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Our Misty Blue fades dramatically in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The collapsing pace creates a sprint finish where the closers can unleash their kicks from off the pace. Timely Affair and Spirit Of Bowland have the tactical speed to capitalize when the race falls apart.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Our Misty Blue handles the distance better than his recent fade suggests
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows him to dictate terms and potentially hold on if his stamina reserves prove adequate. Back From Dubai could emerge from the chasing pack to challenge but not catch.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the main contenders fail to handle the tactical puzzle or meet traffic problems
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with several runners underperforming, allowing an outsider to sneak through. Haaf A Diamond showed promise in cheekpieces last time and could benefit from a muddling pace.

watchPoints.text: Our Misty Blue could set unsustainable fractions despite being the lone leader, given his tendency to fade in the finish
Timely Affair needs the front runners to come back to him significantly in the final furlong to be effective
Heretic could benefit most from the tactical setup as a prominent runner returning to his preferred 1m distance
Back From Dubai may not get the strong pace he needs to showcase his finishing kick from a forward position
Spirit Of Bowland has proven C&D form but relies heavily on the race developing into a sprint finish

races.paceDynamic: Gold Star Gazing is the only confirmed front runner with a prominent style, likely to get an uncontested lead in this 6f novice event. With most of the field showing hold-up or unknown styles, including the two unexposed runners Elite Approach and Sugar Bon Bon, there's minimal early pace pressure. Gold Star Gazing can dictate fractions from the front while prominent runners Hugh and Likeadyinwasp track behind. This setup strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace early, as the lack of genuine speed will create a tactical disadvantage for hold-up horses trying to close from too far back over the minimum trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Gold Star Gazing gets a soft lead without early pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of pace opposition allows him to control the race and kick clear in the final furlong, while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back over 6f. His previous RPR of 80 and proven form at this trip makes him hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Hugh or another prominent runner can sit close enough to Gold Star Gazing's shoulder
scenarios.body: The tracker gets first run on the leader and benefits from the slow early pace by having enough left to outkick Gold Star Gazing in the final 100 yards. Hugh showed promise on debut and suits this tactical scenario perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Unexposed Runner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Elite Approach or Sugar Bon Bon shows significant improvement from their unknown baselines
scenarios.body: One of the newcomers to this yard has been working well at home and benefits from the moderate early pace to deliver a surprise performance. Their unknown style could be more prominent than catalogued, giving them tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rallies
scenarios.trigger: If Wezzeer or Forest Phoenix gets the perfect ride and a strong pace collapse occurs
scenarios.body: The early pace goes even slower than expected, allowing a hold-up horse to time their run perfectly and catch the leaders napping in the final 50 yards. This requires everything to fall right given the trip and likely race shape.

watchPoints.text: Gold Star Gazing getting any early pressure from Hugh or Likeadyinwasp would completely change the pace dynamics
Elite Approach or Sugar Bon Bon showing more prominent early positioning than their unknown styles suggest
Wezzeer or Forest Phoenix being held up too far back given the likely slow early pace over 6f
Hugh's positioning in the first two furlongs will indicate if he can challenge Gold Star Gazing tactically
Any market moves on the two completely unexposed runners Elite Approach and Sugar Bon Bon

races.paceDynamic: Shazani provides the only confirmed front-running presence and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting sustainable fractions without early pressure. Tabby and Belsito may track prominently behind Shazani, but the majority of this field comprises hold-up horses including Fan Mail, Glamour Show, Dicko The Legend, Thurso, and Neyva's Angel. With minimal early pace pressure, Shazani can control the tempo and kick clear in the straight. This tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the late traffic problems that will engulf the crowded pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Shazani Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Shazani gets an easy lead and dictates moderate fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: Shazani can kick clear turning for home while the hold-up horses get caught in traffic behind the slow pace. The lack of early speed allows front-runners to dominate while closers struggle to make up ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get bunched up behind the modest early pace
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses will be looking for racing room simultaneously in the straight, creating a messy finish. Those who get the clearest run or find gaps earliest will prevail over those trapped behind horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Tabby or Belsito can track Shazani and time their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The prominent horses can follow Shazani's pace-setting before striking in the final furlong when the leader weakens. Their tactical position gives them first jump on the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shazani Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Shazani gets completely uncontested fractions and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: With no pace pressure whatsoever, Shazani can dictate crawling splits before quickening when it matters. The hold-up horses will have too much ground to make up from the steady tempo.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Shazani getting uncontested lead - if no horse goes with him early, he'll dictate perfect fractions for front-runners
Watch the hold-up horses Fan Mail, Glamour Show, and Dicko The Legend getting bunched up behind the modest pace
Watch Tabby's fitness on quick turnaround after impressive stable debut - any signs of fatigue will be telling
Watch Neyva's Angel's starting position - his typical slow breaks could be fatal if trapped behind crawling pace
Watch for any prominent horse willing to pressure Shazani early - could change entire complexion of race
